summary: Avoid scanning runtime claim history when checking generic status visibility.

replay.detail: Existing projections and authoritative claims are unchanged; no replay is required.

schema.detail: Uses existing subject/kind indexes without changing stored data or schema.

rules.detail: Reserved-kind isolation and snapshot-cut semantics are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Generic status visibility uses four indexed existence probes instead of enumerating historical subject/kind pairs; returned subjects are unchanged.

manual.detail: No manual migration or configuration changes are required.

recovery.detail: Reverting restores the historical scan without data conversion or recovery steps.
